picker.title: Unpaid orders
picker.searchPlaceholder: Order ID, name, phone or transfer content...

order.label: Pick an unpaid order
order.info: Only unpaid, non-cancelled orders are listed.

manual.transferCodeInfo: The code on the statement, for example DHG29JR5A8 (not case-sensitive). The session that carries this code is marked as paid, even if it has expired.
manual.amountInfo: The amount actually received, whole VND. If it differs from the session amount you will be asked to confirm.
manual.referenceInfo: The SePay transaction ID or the statement reference, if known. Left empty, the transfer content is used as the reference.
manual.providerInfo: Default: SePay when there is a reference, Manual when there is only the transfer content.
manual.transferContentInfo: Only needed when the statement shows something other than the transfer code.

note.label: Reason / evidence
note.info: Required. Say why you are confirming (for example: checked against the statement of …).

errors.amount: Enter a whole VND amount above 0
errors.note: Please enter a reason or evidence

orderTab.noAttempts: No QR code was ever created for this order.
orderTab.noTransactions: No transaction is attached to this order yet.

qr.alt: Payment QR code of the order
qr.waiting: Waiting for the customer's transfer. The code expires {date}.
qr.expired: This code has expired. Create a new one if the customer has not paid yet.
qr.superseded: Earlier code expired: {codes}. If the customer already paid with an old code, confirm it manually.

confirm.title: Create a new QR
confirm.message: The current code expires immediately. If the customer already transferred with the old code, confirm it manually.

present.title: Payment QR code
present.scan: Scan with your banking app to pay

lookup.searchPlaceholder: Transfer content, order ID, phone or customer name...
lookup.noTransactions: No money received for this code

pending.title: {count, plural, one {# transaction to reconcile} other {# transactions to reconcile}}
pending.includes: Money arrived in the account but the system could not match it to an order: no order code found, wrong amount, paid after the code expired, or the code was cancelled.
pending.excludes: Transactions already attached to an order, matched automatically, duplicate payments and outgoing money are not counted.
pending.how: Open the transaction, check the bank statement, then attach it to the right order with "Attach to order". If the customer paid a different amount and the shop accepts it, confirm the mismatch when asked.
pending.note: Money sent by mistake, unrelated to any order, stays in this number until it is attached to an order.
